task.title: Restore atomic task-scoped quota/auth fallback after post-merge coordinator race
task.phase: Supervisor reliability / assignment fallback topology operator V4

source_decisions.head: d40b73adabec3eba27f6fa111586fc956d7bfe74
source_decisions.decision: Configured identities remain distinct; account/quota and reviewer eligibility follow configuration plus task-scoped live evidence.
Replace only the dependency record corrupted by the post-merge coordinator race; preserve the implementation objective and account-neutral boundary.
The packet contradicted the explicit operator constraint and was admitted after PR #4499 had already been approved and merged.
Reapply code and regression design on current dev under the V4 Task-ID; do not reuse prior status, review, checks, or trailers as delivery authority.

scope.owned_layer: Supervisor assignment-pair planning, configured/preferred fallback traversal, canonical assignment compare-and-swap, and regression evidence.
scope.not_changing: Account or quota groups, provider readiness policy, global reviewer bans, configuration, catalog contracts, product tasks, canonical JSON by hand, live runtime state, services, deployment, or rollout.

contract.pair_planning: Every automatic owner fallback is evaluated together with an independent reviewer candidate before canonical mutation; the incumbent reviewer may become owner when another viable reviewer completes the pair.
contract.candidate_order: Direct configured fallbacks retain declaration order, task-preferred lanes follow, and discovered mapping edges are traversed breadth-first with case-insensitive de-duplication.
contract.bounded_cycles: Traversal is bounded by finite unique candidate names and terminates when mappings contain cycles such as Antigravity -> Codex2 -> Antigravity.
contract.atomic_persistence: The canonical lock compares expected owner, reviewer, and status before assigning both fields in the same governed write.
contract.shared_consumers: Mainline normalization, helper claim dispatch, and worker-failure owner fallback consume plan_task_assignment_pair.
contract.fail_closed: Catalog-locked tasks, tasks without a viable distinct pair, and stale compare-and-swap inputs are not mutated.
contract.identity_boundary: Reviewer independence remains distinct configured agent identity; Codex/Codex2 mutual review is allowed and no account/quota-group rule is added.

reproduce_23_stranded_tasks.result: All 23 unavailable-Antigravity/Codex2-reviewer todo tasks plan and persist Codex2 owner with Codex reviewer.

verification.result: checkout-scoped .venv-pantheon provisioned; pytest and project imports verified

verification.command: cd .orchestrator && ../.venv-pantheon/bin/python -m pytest -q test_supervisor.py -k 'pair_planner or normalize_mainline_task_assignment or helper_claim or persist_task_reassignment or WorkerReassignmentTests'

residual_risks: The planner consumes current provider/auth/pause signals; a later signal change is handled by the same fail-closed replanning path rather than this source delivery.
A compare-and-swap rejection intentionally leaves the newer canonical assignment untouched and requires a subsequent supervisor cycle to plan from fresh state.
This task is source-only and does not authorize live supervisor rollout or service mutation.

review.notes: Awaiting independent Human/Ops exact-head code, test, scope, source-chain, and evidence review of PR #4501. The governed handoff and approval bind GitHub headRefOid because a committed manifest cannot self-reference its containing commit.

delivery.exact_head_binding: GitHub headRefOid supplied as REVIEW_HEAD_SHA by the governed handoff and approval; intentionally not self-referenced in this committed manifest.
delivery.rollback: Revert the V4 task merge commit to restore incumbent field-by-field fallback selection; no state or config migration is required.
